title: Tintinnabulum source descriptor
description: Where live data comes from, how often to fetch it, and which mapping turns it into events. Together with a mapping profile this is a complete connector, as a document rather than as code.

name.description: Identifies the source. Also its filename: sources/<name>.json.

enabled.description: Start polling when the server starts. Off by default: a checked-out repository should not begin calling other people's APIs on its own.

url.description: Must be https, except against localhost. May contain ${env.NAME} references, which are resolved where the runner runs and never stored or returned.

headers.description: Values may contain ${env.NAME}. This is where an API token belongs; never inline one.

body.description: Sent as JSON when method is POST.

interval.description: Milliseconds between polls. Respect the API's rate limit: this is the number that gets a key revoked.

dedupeSize.description: How many recent keys to remember, so a poll that returns the same items again does not replay them.

fetch.description: Poll an endpoint on an interval. Give this or "stream", never both.

items.description: An expression selecting the array of things in the response. Omit it when the response is already the array.

key.description: An expression giving each item a stable identity, used to recognise what has already been heard. Defaults to the event's id.

spread.description: Fraction of the interval over which a batch is spread. A poll returning forty items is otherwise forty notes at once, heard as a glitch rather than as forty things. 0 emits them together.

profile.description: A profile name from profiles/, or a whole mapping document inline.

stream.description: Hold a connection open instead of polling. Give this or "fetch", never both.

url.description: wss: for a websocket, https: for Server-Sent Events. May contain ${env.NAME}.

protocol.description: Inferred from the url scheme when omitted.

subscribe.description: A JSON message, or several, sent once the socket opens. Many feeds say nothing until asked.

reconnect.description: Milliseconds before the first reconnection attempt. The delay grows with consecutive failures.

maxPerSecond.description: A firehose can outrun both the ears and the screen. 0 means every message.

dedupeSize.description: 0 disables it, which is right for a stream that never repeats itself.

expand.description: A second stage, for a list endpoint that returns identities rather than records. Each value from "items" is substituted into this url and fetched, and the result is what the profile maps. Polled sources only.

url.description: Must contain ${item}, the value taken from "items".

limit.description: How many identities to follow per poll.

concurrency.description: How many at a time. A hundred at once is how a polite poll becomes an attack.
